recipes.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. It fights target creature you don't control.
• Counter target spell unless its controller pays {3}.
• Creatures with power 3 or less can't block this turn.

recipe_coverage: Complete source identity and Oracle text are pinned. Actual parent and response casts use stack1/stack2 and normal legality, payment and selection for both controllers. Tests cover printed fixed or derived taxes, pay/decline/exact/unaffordable decisions, source costs and missing resources, typed targets, own/opposing spells, selected/unselected permanents, exact zone multiplicities and ordered libraries, and snapshot replay as applicable. Fight/stat and blocking-restriction modes are not selected. Invalid counter-mode availability when another mode is legal remains untested. Countered response sources, lost targets, replacement/prevention, simultaneous responses and multiplayer remain separate gaps.
